name: Dumaguete

queries.query: Dumaguete official cadastral map parcel GIS Philippines
queries.result: First-party discovery found the official Dumaguete City Planning and Development Office page. It states that the CPDO maintains cadastral and other maps and provides copies on request for a fee. The official Philippine Geoportal and NAMRIA/LMB sources were also found; Geoportal metadata identifies an LMB Parcel data layer.

queries.query: mapang kadastral at mapa ng mga parsela Dumaguete opisyal
queries.result: The first-party search did not expose a separate Filipino-language Dumaguete parcel viewer. The official Dumaguete CPDO page remained the relevant local source and the national Philippine Geoportal remained the relevant public map platform.

registryEvidence.custodian: Dumaguete City Planning and Development Office (local cadastral-map custodian/procedure); Philippine Geoportal / Land Management Bureau (national parcel-data platform).
registryEvidence.scope: The city CPDO page evidences local custody of cadastral maps and an assistance procedure, including map copies on request and payment. This is distinct from the national Geoportal LMB layer, whose metadata says its parcel data covers selected areas in Metro Manila.
registryEvidence.scopeNote: Local city map custody and national agency/platform prose are kept separate; no national parcel layer was treated as Dumaguete coverage without spatial evidence.

parcelDiscovery.crs: Geoportal LMB parcel layer metadata reports EPSG:3857; no Dumaguete geometry response was obtained.

boundedResponse.note: The public GeoServer request timed out without a response. This is not evidence of citywide absence or map-extent absence.
